plugins.name: discordsimple-connector
plugins.description: Let Claude post announcements and briefs to your Discord channels through DISCORDsimple, a multi-tenant remote MCP server operated by CCMS Hosting. List your channels, post text or rich embeds, and read recent history to avoid double-announcing. @everyone and role pings are disabled; message content is not stored. Free: 1 server, 2 channels, 50 actions/month. Pro: $9/month for up to 10 servers, unlimited channels, embeds, 5,000 actions/month.
